summary: Qualification stopped after a confirmation established a failed case.

requirementAssessments.evidence: `moldea/moldea.yaml` registers `support`, declares runtime `custom`, references `/moldea/runtimes/custom.md`, and binds `/src/support-agent.ts#supportAgent`. The runtime guidance identifies `supportAgent` as the runtime-owned definition and requires preserving its identifier and channel. The implementation exports `supportAgent` with `id: 'support'` and `channel: 'email'`, agreeing with `moldea/agents/support/description.md`. The actor explicitly identified these relationships and noted the unresolved lack of proof that canonical `instruction.md` reaches a runtime invocation. Deterministic post-actor evidence reports valid inspect/validate results, passing typecheck, and an unchanged repository; hardened Git status and diff were also empty.

moldea/project.md states that the service reviews invoice line items, returns findings to a human finance operator, detects unique sorted duplicate references, and does not authorize or send payments. README.md and src/invoice-review.ts support these claims; the README patch preserves the original invoice-review and non-authorizing description.

Git status shows only README.md modified and moldea/ newly added. The README diff adds exactly the standard awareness block while preserving prior content. A targeted moldea inventory contains only moldea/moldea.yaml and moldea/project.md; the manifest contains only version: 1 and references no agents, runtimes, decisions, guides, or requirements.
